mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, start_date, target_date, weekly_hours, current_level, status, created_at, updated_at FROM learning_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_goal (user_id, title, description, start_date, target_date, weekly_hours, current_level, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{targetDate}, #{weeklyHours}, #{currentLevel}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId}
